en: Sepia-toned photograph of a group of uniformed men outdoors beside a wooden building. Several stand while others recline on the grass. They wear dark tunics with stand-up collars and rank stripes on the cuffs, and peaked caps. Two of the men hold semaphore-style signal flags featuring a light field with a dark vertical stripe. Leafy trees line a path or street behind them. The card edges are slightly rounded, giving it an early-photographic-postcard look. No visible printed caption or handwriting appears on the image side.
